sections.heading: To prepare
items: Pat chicken pieces in almonds til coated on each side.
Deep fry in hot oil til golden brown.
This appetizer can also be made with sliced walnuts or with light sesame seeds.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: one 3 lb. chicken cut up into small pieces

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Heat 2 TB oil in the wok. Stir fry the chicken until light brown in color.
Add seasonings above and cook until sauce reduces and chicken is shiny and glazed with the sauce. Serve immediately.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1/2 pkg bean thread noodles (cooked and cut into 2 inch lengths)

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Bring water to a boil. Just before it reaches the boiling point drop in the chicken. Cook for about 10 minutes (don't overcook) and then remove the chicken from the water and allow it to cool off.
Place the chicken on top of the vegetables and noodles, which have been spread out on a platter.
Mix the seasonings together and pour the mixture over the top of the chicken and serve.
Sprinkle salt and wine on the chicken.
Broil the chicken 20 inches from the broiler for 15 minutes on each side. Brush with the sauce and serve with a lemon slice on top.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Marinate chicken in sauce for 24 hrs. or more.
Place chicken on skewer, alternating with scallions.
Barbeque on charcoal grill, turning over for a few minutes.
Baste with marinating sauce while on grill.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 LB chicken breast - cut into 1 inch slices

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Bring the sauce mixture to a boil. Add the chicken and onion and simmer cook until the onion is soft. Set aside but keep warm.
Place 1 cup each of the steamed rice in serving bowls with covers.
In a small sauce pan bring 1/6 of the chicken and onion sauce from (1) to a boil. Add beaten egg and scallion and when the egg has firmed up pour over the rice in the bowls and serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 3lb. whole chicken or 6 boneless half chicken breasts
1 stick of scallion and one slice of ginger

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Heat 4 cups of water to a boil in a saucepan. When boiling put one stick of scallion and one slice of ginger in with the chicken pieces. Poach for 10 minutes. Remove and soak immediately with cold water.
When chicken is thoroughly cooled, cut the chicken into 1/2 inch wide strips and arrange on a serving platter.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together and pour over chicken. Garnish with parsley.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 green pepper chopped into 1/2 inch squares

sections.heading: To prepare chicken
items: Bone the chicken and cut into 1/2 inch squares.
Marinate in 1 TBS soy sauce and 1 and 1/2 TBS cornstarch for at least 30 minutes.

sections.heading: To cook
items: Heat 1 cup of oil in the wok. When very hot, quick stir fry the chicken for a short time (about 1/2 minute).
Drain the chicken and set aside.
Heat 2 TBS oil in the wok, brown the chili peppers, add the chopped ginger, green pepper, and chicken. Then add the sauce and peanuts, stir for a short time and serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1/4 cup scallion, cut into 1 inch long length
2 cups vegetables: 1/2 c red pepper, 1/2 c pea pods, 1/2 c mushrooms, 1/2 c onions

sections.heading: To cook
items: Marinate the chicken for 15 min. in Sauce (A).
Heat 2 TBS oil in the wok, fry meat until the color changes. Remove the chicken. Put aside.

Heat 2 TBS oil in the wok, brown the scallion and ginger, add the vegetables. When the vegetables has been partly cooked (half done), add the Seasoning Mixture (B). Finally, add the nuts. Stir til hot. Remove to a serving plate.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Wash the chicken thoroughly and dry it with a paper towel, inside and out. Marinate it for 2 hours.
Place the chicken and the marinating mixture in a hot steamer and steam at high heat for 12 minutes then turn the heat off. Leave the chicken in the steamer for 10 additional minutes.
Let the chicken cool off for a short time. Cut it into a pattern and arrange it on a serving platter.
Cut and sprinkle the following ingredients over the top of the chicken.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Cut chicken breasts into 2 large thin slices.
Stuff chicken and deep-fry in hot oil.

title: Sze-Chuan Spicy Cold Noodle with Chicken

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: In a heavy pot put noodle in boiling water and cook until done. Rinse in cold water and drain well. Coat with sauce A tossing well. Chill in refrigerator until very cold.
Arrange noodles on serving platter topping with chicken, bean sprouts, cucumber, and carrots. Pour sauce B on top and serve.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 3lb. whole chicken or 6 boneless half chicken breasts
1 stick of scallion and one slice of ginger

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Heat 4 cups of water to a boil in a saucepan. When boiling put one stick of scallion and one slice of ginger in with the chicken pieces. Poach for 10 minutes. Remove and soak immediately with cold water.
When chicken is thoroughly cooled, cut the chicken into 1/2 inch wide strips and arrange on a serving platter.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together and pour over chicken. Garnish with parsley.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 2 chicken breasts cut into thin strips

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Heat 2 TBS of oil in a hot wok.
Quick stir fry the chicken, add the leek and chili pepper and stir fry together.
Add the seasoning mixture, stir fry momentarily and serve hot.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Bone the chicken and pound it. Cut the chicken into 1 inch cubes and marinate it for 1/2 hour.
Cut the vegetables likewise into 1 inch cubes.
Heat 1 cup of oil and deep fry the chicken cubes for about 1/2 minute, drain and set aside.
Use 2 TBS oil to brown the ginger and scallion. Add the vegetable, chicken, gravy mixture, and nuts. Heat for a short time and serve hot.

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Slice the chicken thin and marinate for 30 minutes.
Bring 4 cups of water to a boil and boil the vegetable mixture for 1 minute, drain, and set aside. Deep fry the chicken in hot oil, drain, and set aside.

Heat 3 TBS oil in the wok and brown the garlic and scallion at high heat. Stir fry the vegetable, add the seasoning mix and meat, and add the cornstarch mixture. Now add the sesame seed oil stir and remove to a serving platter. Serve as is or fry noodles until brown and pour the chicken and vegetables over the noodles and serve.

sections.heading: Additional Ingredients
items: 1 pkg of dried bean thread noodles

sections.heading: To prepare
items: Marinate the chicken in marinating sauce for 15 minutes or more.

Heat 4 cups of oil in the wok. When hot, deep fry the noodles just until the noodles puff up. Drain off the oil and set the noodles aside to cool on a serving platter. When cool, use your hands to break the noodles into small pieces the size of coconut.

Mix 1 TBS cold oil into the chicken and marinating sauce mixture. Heat 2 TBS oil in the wok. When the oil is very hot, quickly stir fry the chicken and remove it from the heat as soon as it changes color.

In the same wok, heat 2 TBS oil and stir fry mixture A until evenly cooked and the flavor comes out. Add the chicken and peapods and the seasoning sauce and mix well. If too thick, or more sauce is desired, add 1 to 2 TBS water. Serve hot over the fried noodles with pinenut sprinkled on the top. Roll the lettuce leaves with 1/4 cup of the mixture and serve hot.

sections.heading: Note
items: This dish is not often available at typical Chinese restaurants yet it is a refreshing dish when served in the summertime. The dish can be made quite attractive if the ingredients are cut such that all of the pieces are a uniform size, small being the best size.
